content: How can we be sure the data set is relevant? On average vehicles on United States roads are 11.6 years old, making the average manufacturing year 2006-2007 BIBREF6, BIBREF7. In order to have a relevant data set we gather all of the available reviews for car models made between the years 2000 and 2018.
